baseline: Security policy baseline. Scope: all employees using sensitive production systems. Employees must complete security training within 30 days after first sensitive production-system access. No exceptions apply.
replacement: Security policy replacement. Scope: all employees using sensitive production systems. Employees must complete security training before any sensitive production-system access is granted. No exceptions apply.

cases.procedure: HR procedure A. Scope: all employees using sensitive production systems. HR must grant employees sensitive production-system access on their first day of employment. Employees may complete security training within 30 days after their first day. No exceptions apply.
cases.reason: Access is granted before mandatory training, for the same employees and systems with no applicable exception.

cases.procedure: HR procedure B. Scope: all employees using sensitive production systems. HR must withhold sensitive production-system access until the employee has completed security training. Day-one onboarding accounts have no sensitive production-system permissions. No exceptions apply.
cases.reason: Sensitive-system access is blocked until training; day-one accounts have a different permission scope.

limitation: Small workflow smoke dataset. Broader ambiguity, exception and missing-requirement evaluation requires Phase 4 approval.
